name: SRK Staring at Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla in Darr Holi Scene
visual_description: Two-panel meme from Darr (1993). Top shows Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla happily embracing during Holi. Bottom shows Shah Rukh Khan in disguise with colored face playing a tambourine and staring enviously.
usage_context: Used to express jealousy, FOMO, third-wheeling, or secretly plotting while watching others celebrate.

example.bottom_text: Me single and plotting their downfall
